run.name: Open Text Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (OTEX)
run.summary: OPEN TEXT CORP is a cash-generative credit that has reduced total debt to adjusted EBITDA to 3.10x, but falling support and license revenue and a lower FY2027 outlook put further deleveraging at risk. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is OPEN TEXT CORP.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (issuer-defined), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 5,836,525 and cash 956,024 at June 30, 2026 over adjusted EBITDA of 1,903,162 for FY2026; restricted cash excluded; letters of credit and guarantees not added

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 1,903,162 over cash paid for interest 321,694; gross of 41,976 interest received

cash.basis: Cash. June 30, 2026 balance sheet; revolver had no outstanding balance; maturity December 19, 2028, about 29 months after the date

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Ratings, executed debt documents, letters of credit, covenant earnings and post-refinancing cash are not supplied, and the outlook is management language.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant earnings, letters of credit and post-refinancing cash are not supplied, so headroom and liquidity after October 2026 cannot be fully measured.
